stories.title: Bonus Wrap: Harvey, Jus Mundi, LI NY +
stories.ltme_summary: Artificial Lawyer's bonus round-up covers several legal technology and law firm items from the week. Akin and its Funds Frontier Lab launched Living Fund File, a fund-lifecycle knowledge product. eDiscovery company DISCO hired Mich Razon as chief technology officer, and Johann Wrede as chief marketing officer. CLM provider Leah launched Harness Builder, and Harvey launched a litigation and investigations capability built on its fact graph. Agiloft added AI agents, and Orbital launched Scots law workflows piloted with Pinsent Masons.
stories.hook: Harvey, Agiloft and Leah ship new agents while Akin and Pinsent Masons put AI into practice work

stories.title: FTC’s $49.75 Million Deal With Progress Residential Signals Rising Scrutiny of Rental Pricing
Ten questions law firm leaders are pondering right now – plus one off the wall
stories.ltme_summary: Simon P Marshall, founder of TBD Marketing, writes in LawFuel that law firm leaders at a conference were focused on the possible dissolution of Weil, not on the formal agenda. He says TBD's analysis of five months of LinkedIn posts found far more references to growth and awards than to pricing or restructuring. The column then sets out ten questions leaders are asking, including how to keep rainmakers.
stories.hook: Law firm leaders are privately worried about Weil's collapse while public posts focus on awards, argues TBD Marketing

stories.title: Court finds law firm negligent over “simple human error”
stories.ltme_summary: A High Court judge sitting in Manchester has ordered Ratio Law to pay £100,000 plus interest to MPP (Services) Ltd. The firm admitted that a partner, Gisela Alberici, accidentally deleted the sum secured from a draft legal charge on a property, leaving it void. The judge described Ms Alberici as an unimpressive witness who gave the matter only the bare minimum of attention. The article is a court report on the claim.
stories.hook: Ratio Law ordered to pay £100,000 after a partner deleted the secured sum from a property charge
